title: Constellation
suits: space, AI and research, networks and graphs, maps and discovery, education: products about finding patterns and connecting points

params.--field: the sky by day; it is shaded to dusk, so the field's own colour glows on the horizon (any colour or gradient)
params.--brand: the accent star (used if it reads on the dusk sky)
params.--brand-2: a second star tint, and the fallback accent
params.--const-dusk: the dusk the field is shaded with (r,g,b)
params.--const-fs: wordmark size (long names shrink to fit 1600 px)
params.__MARK__: stroke paths in a 24 x 24 box: corners become stars, shared corners merge, a dot becomes the accent star

details: the field is shaded to dusk, so any brand colour becomes the afterglow on the horizon
300 field stars, denser up high and thinning toward the glow, each twinkling at its own rate
a few field stars carry the accent and second tint, like coloured stars
the mark's strokes are reduced to their corners (Ramer-Douglas-Peucker); shared corners merge into one star
the mark's stars appear first, a little brighter than the field, so the eye finds them
lines draw star to star in stroke order and stop short of each star, like a printed star chart
every star flares with a four-point diffraction spike as its line arrives
a dot in the mark (or the last corner) becomes the accent star
field stars keep clear of the mark so no stray star sits on a line
the wordmark rises in letter by letter out of a blur
a dark ridge with a small observatory dome; its slit catches a little light and one window glows, flickering like a lamp moving inside
at rest the mark's stars breathe slightly on the deck clock
every 19 s a shooting star crosses with a fading tail, once the mark is up
